blocking_issues.title: Repeated smoke restores mutate their Adam baseline; the required tail identity check fails
blocking_issues.requirement: DESIGN_SPECIFICATION.md 5.3, 7.4, acceptance criteria 3 and 5: independent diagnostic/source identity comparisons on disposable matching full/tail states before formal RUN.
blocking_issues.cause: smoke_identities captures base once and reset repeatedly passes its optimizer tensors to restore. restore calls opt.load_state_dict directly. PyTorch 2.9 noncapturable/nonfused Adam keeps step on CPU, and Optimizer._process_value_according_to_param_policy returns the input step tensor unchanged. Adam therefore increments a tensor still owned by base. CPU restoration also aliases same-device moments.
blocking_issues.trigger: The first useful full-batch update creates Adam state. The next smoke_identities call, for the natural tail, captures this populated optimizer. Its off run advances the saved step 1 to 2; the on run restores the already-mutated baseline and advances it to 3. The comparison at line 520 fails.
blocking_issues.impact: The first dataset/arm smoke case cannot complete its mandatory tail identity check and writes SMOKE_TECHNICAL_PAUSE. No successful six-case SMOKE_REPORT or formal RUN signoff can be obtained. This is a smoke implementation defect, not evidence that the algorithm or diagnostics change training.
evidence: Focused CPU execution of the actual smoke_identities after one synthetic Adam update raised AssertionError; post-step counter was 3.
Direct pointer comparison after restore confirmed optimizer step aliases the saved baseline step; capturable=false, fused=false.
Installed torch/optim/adam.py:165 explicitly hosts step on CPU when capturable/fused are off; torch/optim/optimizer.py:780-784 returns that step unchanged, including when model parameters are CUDA.
In-memory wrapper copying only state[optimizer] before the existing restore made the same warmed-state probe pass diagnostic_on_off, lambda_zero, all_single_class and restore counter 1.
blocking_issues.minimal_fix: Give every smoke reset fresh optimizer tensors before load_state_dict, for example pass a copy of base[optimizer] in reset (or clone the optimizer state at restore). Keep base immutable across all comparisons; retain source Adam, counters, operation order and the fixed scientific protocol.
blocking_issues.required_retest: A small CPU fixture must perform one useful update before invoking the real smoke_identities; assert all three identity comparisons pass, the saved baseline is unchanged, and the final restored counter equals its original value. Rebind changed source and obtain a fresh distinct code review. Then perform the already-required six real full/tail/validation/RAM cases and separate smoke/resource review.
